17707065.brief: Metlen Energy & Metals repurchased 128,979 shares at €43.20 average price during 20-24 July under its buyback programme.
17707065.take: Routine execution of previously-announced buyback programme within normal parameters; demonstrates capital allocation but no material surprise or strategic signal for investors.

17707066.summary: Volex purchased 530,000 shares through Peel Hunt LLP during 20-24 July 2026 at prices ranging from 506p to 545p, with a weighted average price of 518.17p. The shares will be cancelled, reducing issued share count to 183,847,640. This forms part of a buyback programme announced 7 April 2026. The cancellation reduces the denominator for FCA Disclosure Guidance calculations.
17707066.brief: Volex PLC repurchased 530,000 ordinary shares (25p each) between 20-24 July 2026 at 506-545p per share.
17707066.take: Share buyback reduces issued shares and can support EPS accretion; routine capital management execution suggests management confidence in valuation. Non-event technically but modestly positive signal.

17707064.summary: Anpario PLC has completed its £3.0 million share buyback programme announced on 27 April 2026. Between 20-24 July 2026, the company purchased final 40,988 shares at prices between 547-550p, bringing total buyback to 556,803 shares at an average price of 538.79p. All repurchased shares will be cancelled, reducing issued share capital from 20,069,026 to 20,039,026 shares, with an additional 29,000 treasury shares also being cancelled.
17707064.brief: Anpario completes £3m share buyback programme, repurchasing 556,803 shares at average 538.79p per share.
17707064.take: Share buyback completion signals management confidence in valuation and demonstrates capital discipline, though execution at relatively modest per-share prices suggests limited upside pressure. Market likely views this neutrally as a routine capital management action.

17707071.summary: UBS Europe SE will act as Stabilising Manager for Aktor S.A.'s EUR 300 million EUR 5NC2 Senior bond issue. Stabilisation period runs from 27 July to 1 September 2026, with an over-allotment facility of up to 5%. The manager may over-allot securities or undertake market-supporting transactions, though stabilisation action is not assured and may be terminated at any time.
17707071.brief: UBS to stabilise EUR 300m Aktor senior bond offering from 27 July to 1 September 2026.
17707071.take: Standard pre-stabilisation notice for corporate bond issuance; routine disclosure indicating normal market support mechanisms during distribution phase with no material implications for equity investors.

17707069.summary: GCP Infrastructure Investments Ltd purchased 625,000 ordinary shares on 24 July 2026 through Canaccord Genuity at a volume-weighted average price of 82.51p, with a range of 82.00p to 82.60p. This is part of a broader buyback programme announced 12 December 2024, under which the company has cumulatively purchased 80,984,363 shares for treasury. Following the transaction, 884,797,669 shares remain in issue with 786,828,287 voting rights outstanding.
17707069.brief: GCP Infrastructure repurchased 625,000 shares at average 82.51p on 24 July under existing buyback authority.
17707069.take: Routine capital management activity; buybacks at modest discount to NAV suggest management confidence, though share price stability rather than significant value accretion is the typical implication.

17707074.summary: Sterling Strategic Value Fund S.A., a Luxembourg-registered SICAV-RAIF, has disposed of its entire voting stake in Dialight PLC. The fund's holding fell from 7.82% to 0% following a transaction on 22 July 2026, with notification to the company completed on 24 July 2026. The disposal was executed in Luxembourg.
17707074.brief: Sterling Strategic Value Fund exits Dialight position, reducing holding from 7.82% to zero.
17707074.take: A significant shareholder exit suggests loss of confidence in Dialight's strategic value proposition or reflects fund portfolio rebalancing; market may view negatively if exit was distressed or positively if fund reallocating to better opportunities.

17707073.summary: Group revenue reached £73.8m (+8.5% YoY) with system sales of £98.3m. UK like-for-like sales grew 6.2% annually, significantly outperforming CGA benchmark (-1.3%). H1 2026 shows acceleration: UK LFL sales +13.9%, with delivery up 54.1% post multi-aggregator expansion. Adjusted EBITDA £1.1m (UK £6.3m offset by France loss of £5.2m). France integration resulted in £2.7m accounting adjustment identified in May 2026; seven Fresh Burritos sites converted with encouraging Q2 LFL +22.1%, but three loss-making sites closed. Adjusted net debt £10.8m.
17707073.brief: Tortilla reports FY25 results with strong UK momentum and delivery expansion, but France accounting issues and losses persist.
17707073.take: Strong operational recovery in core UK business with technology investments and multi-aggregator strategy delivering material momentum masks ongoing France turnaround challenges and recent accounting control weaknesses that triggered trading suspension.

17707075.summary: Shell plc purchased 70,010 shares for cancellation on 24 July 2026 via the London Stock Exchange at prices ranging from £32.91 to £33.27, with a volume-weighted average price of £33.08 per share. The purchases were executed by Goldman Sachs International under the company's share buyback programme announced 7 May 2026, conducted in compliance with UK Listing Rules and Market Abuse Regulations. No trades occurred on Chi-X or BATS venues.
17707075.brief: Shell repurchases 70,010 shares on LSE at average price of £33.08 as part of May buyback programme.
17707075.take: Routine share buyback execution under pre-announced programme; demonstrates capital return activity but signals no material change in strategy or company outlook.

17707080.summary: Saba Capital Management, L.P. notified on 24 July 2026 that it crossed a major shareholding threshold in Gore Street Energy Storage Fund PLC on 23 July. The entity now holds 17.01% total voting rights, comprising 5.87% from direct share ownership (29.66m shares) and 11.13% from total return swaps expiring 15 December 2026 (56.24m voting rights). Previous notification showed 16.78% holding. Ultimate controlling person is Boaz Weinstein.
17707080.brief: Saba Capital Management crosses 17% voting threshold in Gore Street Energy Storage Fund via share purchases and total return swaps.
17707080.take: Saba Capital's increased stake suggests active positioning in renewable energy storage infrastructure; holding structure via derivatives indicates tactical positioning rather than long-term strategic control, likely neutral to slightly positive on sentiment.

17707081.summary: Restore plc purchased 145,000 ordinary shares through Investec Bank between 20-24 July 2026 at a volume-weighted average price of 278.02p, with prices ranging from 272p to 283p. The shares will be cancelled, reducing total shares in issue to 134,625,076. This is part of the company's ongoing share buyback programme.
17707081.brief: Restore PLC repurchased 145,000 shares at 272-283p between 20-24 July 2026 for cancellation.
17707081.take: Share buybacks typically signal management confidence in valuation and can modestly support EPS through reduced share count, though the modest scale suggests routine capital management rather than material shareholder value creation.

17707083.summary: Morgan Stanley & Co. International plc notified the acquisition of a major holding in European Opportunities Trust PLC, crossing the 5% disclosure threshold. The entity holds 2,420,055 voting rights representing 5.186635% of total voting rights as of 22 July 2026. The notification was filed on 24 July 2026. All voting rights are held directly; no financial instruments are involved.
17707083.brief: Morgan Stanley & Co. International plc crossed 5% voting rights threshold in European Opportunities Trust PLC on 22 July 2026.
17707083.take: Routine regulatory disclosure of a major shareholding; typical institutional investment activity in an investment trust with no obvious strategic implications.

17707082.summary: ITV has postponed its meeting of holders of €500m 4.25% Notes due 2032 from 28 July to 5 August 2026. The meeting will vote on an Extraordinary Resolution regarding potential amendments to the notes. With approximately 73% of consent instructions received supporting the resolution, ITV extended voting deadlines to 31 July and increased the consent fee to 0.25% of principal to encourage broader participation from interested noteholders.
17707082.brief: ITV postpones €500m Notes 2032 meeting from 28 July to 5 August to allow more noteholder participation.
17707082.take: Routine corporate action disclosure. The postponement and fee increase suggest ITV is engineering consent rather than facing opposition, typically a neutral signal that management remains in control of the restructuring process.

17707090.summary: Vast Resources received a binding term sheet for a US$10m two-year debt facility from a major commodity trading group. US$4m is restricted for Aprelevka project expansion; US$6m for working capital. The facility is secured against Vast's Gulf shareholding and includes warrant issuance at 0.3p per share plus offtake rights. The reverse takeover longstop date extended to 17 August 2026. Aprelevka generated US$36.86m revenue and US$8.52m profit before tax in 2025. The company acknowledged significant financial distress, stating insolvency is likely if the transaction fails.
17707090.brief: Vast Resources secures US$10m debt facility and extends reverse takeover longstop date to 17 August 2026.
17707090.take: Critical lifeline for distressed miner, but completion uncertainty remains high. Market will view positively as it provides near-term funding and revenue visibility, though solvency hinges entirely on transaction close before 17 August.

17707089.summary: Imperial Brands PLC executed an on-exchange share repurchase on 24 July 2026, purchasing 218,190 ordinary shares of 10 pence each for cancellation via Barclays Capital Securities Limited. Average price paid was 2,806.1 pence per share, with trades ranging from 2,791.0p to 2,815.0p across multiple trading venues. Following settlement and cancellation, 766,308,438 ordinary shares remain in issue.
